title: Module 07 – Unit Testing and Code Quality

concepts.name: Importance of Testing, assert & Unit Testing Fundamentals

criteria.statement: Writes clear assert statements verifying expected return values.
Explains why pure functions (return values) are easier to unit test than print-only functions.

concepts.name: pytest Fundamentals, Edge Cases & Exception Testing

criteria.statement: Structures test_ files and test_ functions following pytest discovery conventions.
Tests boundary conditions, empty inputs, and expected exceptions (pytest.raises).
Applies PEP 8 naming (snake_case, PascalCase, UPPER_CASE) and clear docstrings.
